snippet.title: All About our Whistles!
snippet.description:
This is the first of many development videos where we can show you behind the scenes updates as we create our game. Today's Dev Vlog is all about the haunting voice of the iron horse: whistles! Listen to our patent-pending tech and how it can simulate over 60 unique whistles with unparalleled realism and tone. We hope you are as thrilled with the quill as we are, and we look forward to having you along for the ride on our development journey!

--Studio 346
